# Skill: Compare Alternatives

Attack an idea with existing tools, workflows, and substitutes.

## Alternatives To Check

- Direct competitors
- Adjacent tools
- Built-in platform features
- Manual workflows
- Spreadsheets or scripts
- Agencies/consultants
- "Do nothing" or "build fast" behavior

## Output

```md
## Existing Alternatives

| Alternative | What it solves | Why it might kill this idea | Remaining gap |
|---|---|---|---|
```

## Rules

- Name specific tools/workflows.
- Link sources when possible.
- If an alternative solves the idea well, recommend killing or narrowing.
